articles.summary: Following Magnera’s Fourth Quarter and Full Year Fiscal 2026 release CEO Curt Begle commented, “We finished Fiscal 2026 with an impressive 8% Adjusted EBITDA improvement in the fourth quarter compared to last year and delivered strong overall results for the full year surpassing prior year by nearly 4%. Through the successful implementation of Project CORE, ongoing realization of synergies, and a relentless focus on operational excellence, we are optimizing our cost structure, enhancing profitability, and generating exceptional cash flow. Our teams delivered these results while navigating inflationary pressures and dynamic demand conditions across our end markets, demonstrating the resilience and flexibility of our operating model.”
articles.title: Magnera Reports Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year Results
